description: The automerge rules of mark1russell7: Renovate merges the low-risk groups when CI passes.

packageRules.description: Renovate merges the npm patch updates when CI passes.

Renovate merges the minor updates of the runtime and development dependencies when CI passes. A range that holds the new version stays the same (rangeStrategy update-lockfile): only the lockfile changes.
Renovate merges a minor or patch update of pnpm when CI passes, also an update of the field packageManager. The release check ignores packageManager.
Before 1.0.0, a minor update can break (SemVer): Renovate never merges it.
The release train merges the minor, patch and digest updates of the GitHub Actions when CI passes and no release is open: a workflow change during a release makes GitHub refuse its tag.
Renovate never merges an update of the Claude Code CLI: it changes the program that runs with the API key. A person reviews it.
